paite: Himahleh Olive tang ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
heading: Numei Ang kawm Lai Mat
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

paite: Zingsang phalvak in tempul ah alut nawn a, mi tengteng akiang ah ahong pai ua, amah atu a, amaute thu ahilh hi.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n numei khat angkawm lai amat uh ahon pi ua; alai ah adingsak uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

paite: Jesu kiang ah, "Sinsakpa, hiai numei angkawm, a-angkawm laitak a amat uh ahi.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

paite: Mosi Dan laibu in hichibang mi suang a denlup thu ahon pia hi; nang bangchi na sa a?" achi uhi.
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

paite: Huai thu amah hekna ding amuhtheihna ding ua, ze-etna dia agen uh ahi. Huchi in Jesu akun a, athugen uh za lou bang in akhutzung in leitual agelh hi.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

paite: Huan adot lailai ziak un amah adaktou a akiang uah, "Na lak ua khelhna nei lou in amah suang in deng masa heh," achi hi.
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

paite: Akun nawn a, akhutzung in leitual agelh nawn hi.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

paite: Amau athugen azak un, upapen a pan atawp pha in, khatkhat in akigelkhia ua; huchi in numei alai a a-omna ngei a om toh Jesu kia a-om uhi.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

paite: Jesu adaktou a, "Numei, koi a om ahi ua? Kuamah in siam louh hon tangsak lou uhia?" achi hi.
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Toupa, kuamah in hon tangsak kei," achi hi. Jesu'n, "Ke'n leng siam louh ka hon tangsak kei; pai inla, tuban khial nawn ke'n," achi hi.
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah thu agen nawn a, "Kei khovel vak ka hi; kei hon zui kuapeuh mial ah akhosa kei ding a, hinna vak anei zaw ding," achi hi.
heading: Jesu Khovel Vak Ahi
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

paite: Huchi in Pharisaite'n akiang ah, "Nangmah thu theisak na hi; na thu theihsak adik kei," achi uhi.
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah thu theisak na hi taleng zong ka thu theihsak adik ahi. Ke'n ka hong kipatna leh ka manohna ding ka thei hi; noute'n bel ka hong kipatna leh ka manohna ding na thei kei uh.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

paite: Nou sadan in vai na hawmsak uh; ke'n kuamah vai ka hawmsak kei.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

paite: Ahi, vai hawmsak na hi taleng zong, ka vai hawmsak adik ding; keimah kia ka hi kei a, kei leh Pa hon sawlpa ka hi zaw uhi.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

paite: Ahi, na dan laibu uah leng mi nih theihpihna adik, chih gelh ahi.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

paite: Kei ka hihleh keimah thu theisakpa ka hi a, Pa hon sawlpa'n ka thu atheisak hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Koi a na Pa om ahia?" achi uhi. Jesu'n, "Nou kei na hon thei kei uh, ka Pa leng na thei kei uh; kei hon thei hi le uchin, ka Pa leng na thei ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

paite: Huai thu tempul a thu ahilh kawm a, sumkoihna mun a agen ahi; ahun a tun nai louh ziak in kuamah in amah aman nai kei uhi.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ka paimang ding a, nou na hon zong ding ua, na khelhna uah na si ding uh; ka hohna ding ah na hong thei kei ding uh," achi nawn hi.
heading: Pa Kiang A Pai Ding Genkholhna
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

paite: Judate'n, "Ka hohna ding ah na hong thei kei ding uh, achih, akihihlum dia adiam?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou nuailam a kipan na hi ua; kei tunglam a kipan ka hi; nou khovel a na hi ua, kei zaw hiai khovel a ka hi kei hi.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

paite: Huaiziak in na kiang uah, na khelhna uah na si ding uh ka chih, huai amah ka hi, chih na gintak kei ualeh na khelhna uah na si ngeingei ding uh," achi hi.
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Atung a kipan in na kiang uah ka genta hi.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

paite: Nou tungtang thu ah thil tampi gen ding leh ngaihtuah ding ka nei; himahleh, hon sawlpa zaw midik ahi; amah kiang a ka thuzakte khovel kiang ah ka hilh ahi," achi hi.
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

paite: Pa thu akiang uah agen chih atheisiam kei uhi.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

paite: Huchi in Jesu mah in, "Nou mihing Tapa na khaikang nung un, amah ka hi chih leh ke'n keimah thu in thil bangmah ka hih kei a, Pa hon hilh bang zel in hiai thu ka gen zaw ahi chih na thei ding uhi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

paite: Hon sawlpa ka kiang ah a-om a, Pa'n kei kia in hon nuse ngei kei; athil kipah lam peuhmah ka hih zel ziak in," achi hi.
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

paite: Huan huai thute agen lai in mi tampi'n amah agingta uhi.
heading: Thutak Suahtakna Ahi
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n amah gingta Judate kiang ah, "Ka thu a na om gige uleh, ka nungzuite na hi taktak ding uhi.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

paite: Huan thutak na thei ding ua, thutak in ahon suaktasak ding,” achi hi.
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, “Abraham suante ka hi ua, tutan in kuamah sal ah ka om ngei kei uh, suahtaksak in na om ding uh bangchi chih a chi na hia?" achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh thil hihkhial khelhna sal ahi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

paite: Sal kichi peuhmah inn ah a-om gige kei a; Tapa bel a-om gige hi.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

paite: Tapa in sal a pan ahon suahtaksakleh na suakta taktak ding uhi.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

paite: Abraham suante na hi uh chih ka thei hi, himahleh hon thah na tum ngal ua, ka thu in noute a mun aneih louh ziak in.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

paite: Ke'n ka Pa kiang a thil ka muh ka gen a; nou leng na pa uh kiang a thil na muh uh na hih uh," achi hi.
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Ka pa uh Abraham ahi," achi ua, adawng uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Abraham tate hi le uchin, Abraham thilhih na hihta ding uhi," achi hi.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

paite: "Himahleh Pathian kiang a thutak ka zak, kei ahon hilhpa ngei, tu'n ah hon thah na tum ngal ua; Abraham in zaw hichibang in ahih kei. Nou zaw na pa uh thil na hih nak uhi," achi hi.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Ang kikawm a piang ka hi kei uh, Pa khat kia ka nei uh, Pathian," achi uhi.
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian na Pa uh hitaleh nou kei na hon it ding uh; Pathian a pan hong pawt leh akiang a kipan hong pai ka hi; keimah thu a hong leng ka hi sam kei, ama'n ahon sawl zaw hi.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

paite: Bangziak a ka thugen theisiam lou? Ka thu na zak theih louh ziak uh ahi.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

paite: Nou zaw na pa uh diabol a pawt na hi ua, na pa uh utna na hih ding uh. Amah zaw atung a kipan tualthat ahi, thutak ah a-om kei; asung a thutak himhim a-om louh ziak in. Zuauthu agen in amah a ngei agen ahi; zuauthei ahi ngal a, zuaupa leng ahi.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

paite: Thutak ka gen ziak in nou hon gingta lou na hi uhi.
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

paite: Na lak uah kua'n ahia khelhna a siam louh hon tan thei om? Thutak ka gen in leng nou bang achia hon gingta lou?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

paite: Pathian a pan pawt in Pathian thu apakta a; Pathian a pan pawt na hih louh ziak un na pakta kei uhi," achi hi.
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

paite: Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Samari mi dawi zawl na hi ka chih uh, ka chi dik ngel uh ahi kei maw?" achi ua, adawng uhi.
heading: Jesu Leh Abraham
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Dawi zawl ka hi kei. Ka Pa ka zahtak ahi zaw, nou kei na hon zahtak kei uhi.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

paite: Himahleh keimah kilawmna zong ka hi kei; azongmi leh angaihtuahmi khat a-om hi.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi'n ka thu azuihleh tangtawn in sihna amu kei ding," achi hi.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

paite: Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Dawi zawl na hi chih tu in ka theita uhi. Abraham asita, zawlneite toh, nang mi'n ka thu azuihleh tangtawn in sihna achiam kei ding, na chi maw.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

paite: Ka pu uh Abraham sang in na thupizaw a hia? Amah leng asita a, zawlneite leng asita uh; kua a kibawl na hia?" achi uhi.
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Keimah kipahtawi hi taleng ka kipahtawina bangmah ahi kei; na Pathian uh, na chih uh ka Pa, hon pahtawipa ahi; nou amah na thei kei uhi.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

paite: Ke'n zaw amah ka thei; amah ka thei kei chi leng noumau bang a zuauthei ka hi ding; huchi in amah ka thei a, athu leng ka zui zel.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

paite: Na pu uh Abraham in ka ni mu ding ahih ziak in akithalawp a, huan amu petmah a, akipak hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

paite: Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Nang kum sawmnga leng hi nailoupi in, Abraham na mu a hia?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Abraham om ma a Ompa ka hi,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

paite: Huchi in adenna ding un suangte atawm ua; himahleh Jesu akibu a, tempul a kipan apawtta hi.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
